title: VERDICT
description: Verifier verdict JSON. Posted by verify sandbox via `loop verdict <file>`. Gate gate_verdict.py checks head_sha binding.

head_sha.description: The commit SHA the verdict is bound to. Must match PR HEAD at submission time.

blind_phase_commit.description: Commit SHA recorded at the end of blind phase (tests written before reading src/).

artifact_digest.description: SHA256 digest of test artifacts directory (tests + fixtures), hex-encoded.

test_plan_version.description: Version identifier of the test plan (e.g. card id + acceptance count).

id.description: AC identifier from card (e.g. AC1, AC2).

pass.description: true = AC passed, false = AC failed.
